reviews.text:
I’m so happy with the experience! Pedro was incredibly accommodating and worked with his schedule to make sure he could groom my baby. From the moment we arrived, he was very attentive.

He did an amazing job grooming my baby, and I couldn’t be happier with how everything turned out. My baby looked so clean, fresh, and adorable! 🐶 He is conveniently close to our house so that was a plus!!!

Highly recommend!

I know my dog can be very hyper active, so when handling him in a specific detailed way, such as trying to pin point something in his body he will instantly start wiggling happily, there’s 2 thing that could have happened here, my Po could have fallen off the table and fell on his face or he got hit bad on his face intentionally,  at first I thought it was a red eye due to shampoo but after the second day his eye was still red I noticed his eye was swollen as well on day 2 with red under his fur, very unprofessional to have not told me my dog got hurt while in their care, even worse if they actually hit him.  LAST TIME ILL EVER TRUST THIS PLACE WITH MY BOY. BEWARE!

I had my 9 month old rescue (Cairn Terrier) for two months and was teaching her to trust humans again because she was abused before. Pedro was afraid he would not be able to cut her hair due to her trust issues. He was able to gain her trust and gave her an amazing first haircut! Coming back all the time!!!
Suck

Pedro does the most amazing job with my cavapoo! He's so wonderful to her, and just a wonderful person altogether! Our beagle bully mix just loves getting pampered and wearing his hanky after he's groomed too!
I had a great experience with Pedro grooming my dog, Max. He handled Max with a lot of care and patience, and the results were excellent. I’m very happy with the service and how Max turned out.
Best Groomer in the Midwest 💯 …
Terrible service, my dog ​​got mange. I don't recommend it.

We took our family dog in for grooming and she came out injured.
No one took responsibility. Constant phone calls ignored. Own claimed he wasn’t the owner until someone called him out.

Be very careful here.

Not happy they dont want to cut my dogs hair the way i want it according to his breed haircut chart.
Update: Giving them another chance 06/15/2025
Pedro was absolutely fantastic! My puppy Mazapan was groomed to perfection. Highly recommend!

I give this place a 5 stars. Pedro was so attentive. He confirms the appointment a day before and he lets you know when you’re ready to pick up ur dog. The payment method is so convenient too. I’ll definitely come back

We absolutely love this place. We take our two little dogs here. Pedro is very professional and the place is very clean. He does a great job as far as styling our animals. He listens to our wants, I told him that one of my dogs was diagnosed with very acute arthritis and he was very sympathetic towards that. He went on to say, he would  handle him very gently. So, as long as he's open, my dogs will be going here.

Excellent service!! Our dog always comes home very happy after getting his bath and haircut here! Pedro did a great job with the haircut, bath, and nail trimming, and the cute bandana is such a cute extra touch.😊Overall we are very pleased with the service here, you can tell that everything here is done with a lot of love and care. …

Pedro did an amazing job with our first visit as a new client. Lucy looks amazing with her new teddy bear cut. We have been trying to find the best groomer for her and finally Found it. She is so ready for the holidays ♥️😍 We are so in love with her new Doo. Thank you so much Pedro. …

I arrived late and Pedro still accepted my dog. Clipped her nails and gave her a super bath, When I picked her up she was so fresh and clean. They also put perfume on the dogs which was an extra plus for me. I'll definitely return for my dogs grooming in the future.

Pedro did an excellent job.  He was able to groom my 5 month Shitzu to perfection. My Shitzu is very playful and moves around alot.  I took her to another location where her hair became tangled shortly after her appointment.  Pedro truly has a special gift , He was able to calm my dog groom her and she now is feeling and looking excellent. Thank so much Pedro , you are truly a master of your craft.  You earned our respect and customer for life.
Had an absolute amazing experience they were prompt and able to squeeze me in. My dog was so happy after and looked and smelled amazing. Would definitely recommend.

Just visited Pedro with my dog Remy for the first time and I already love this place! Pedro was super fast, friendly, communicative, and I could tell he really cared about the dogs. Remy looks amazing after his groom and was so comfortable/happy with this groomer.

Prices are also great! All-around gem!

Update: second visit, my dog was super happy to see Pedro and looks amazing again after! Thank you so much!
Great service.  Good value. My dogs have had zero issues. Highly recommended this place.
Great service
This is the only place I take my dog. Pedro is amazing and always does an excellent job on my dog. Great customer service as well.
